clue.text: By some time before midday completes making restitution

explanation.walkthrough: 'Making' is the link: the wordplay makes the answer, which is defined by 'restitution'.
explanation.definitionFit: To make amends is to offer compensation or repair for a wrong done, which is what restitution means.

clue.text: A gait adapted to stirring music

taken as written

explanation.surface: A dancer's walk altered to keep time with rousing music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stirring' reads as rousing, but means agitated: agitato is the Italian direction to play restlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitato is a musical marking telling performers to play in an excited, restless, agitated manner.

clue.text: Egghead, age about 50, a high-flier

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' looks like an intellectual, but is read as the head of an egg.
explanation.definitionFit: The eagle is a large bird of prey that soars at great altitude, literally flying high.

clue.text: Nothing is returnable in the small department store

parts.note: the short form of department
zero, shaped like O

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A department store's small print saying no goods may be returned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Department store' looks like a shop, but 'store' alone is the definition, a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To deposit something is to put it away for safekeeping, as in a bank or warehouse.

clue.text: Private papers put in good order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Confidential documents being filed neatly.

explanation.definitionFit: Sapper is the rank of the lowest grade of soldier in the British Royal Engineers, equivalent to an army private.

clue.text: Skylights

parts.note: surface reading: windows set into a roof
setter's reading: lights that appear in the sky, the polar glow

explanation.walkthrough: A single word read two ways: roof windows on the surface, the shimmering polar display in the setter's sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The aurora is the coloured glowing display seen in the night sky near the poles, the northern or southern lights.

clue.text: With notices positioned on each side of a road

indicators.note: standing on both sides means enclosing, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: put in position
taken as written
the abbreviation for road

explanation.surface: Signs put up along both verges of a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Placarded means covered with placards, posters or signboards displaying public announcements.

clue.text: Artillerymen with gun to bring up — it's routine

parts.note: the Royal Artillery, abbreviated RA
a Luger is a German pistol

explanation.surface: Gunners hauling up their weapon as part of daily drill.
explanation.definitionFit: Regular means habitual, done at fixed times as part of a normal routine or pattern.

clue.text: The bicycle provided for coppers at one time

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the Victorian bike with one huge and one tiny wheel
second meaning: two old bronze British coins, together worth a penny and a quarter

explanation.surface: A bike issued to the police in the old days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coppers' suggests police officers on bikes; it means copper coins. The farthing was a quarter-penny coin withdrawn in 1960.
explanation.definitionFit: The high-wheeled cycle was named after the two coins because its large and small wheels resembled them side by side.

clue.text: A sound though self-interested organisation

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the sound of a bell or telephone
second meaning: a cartel or clique working for its own gain, like a price-fixing gang

explanation.surface: An organisation that seems sound but is really out for itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A bell's chime is called this, and so is a closed group of dealers or criminals colluding for profit.

clue.text: Change back area plan in advance

parts.note: p for pence, small change
the back part

explanation.surface: A proposal to reorganise the rear of a site before work begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change back' suggests rearranging or reversing, but 'Change' is just the coin abbreviation p.
explanation.definitionFit: To prearrange something is to organise or settle it beforehand, ahead of the time it happens.

clue.text: Through engaging in boastful talk they look hard

parts.note: gas is empty bragging chatter
per means by way of or through, as in per post

explanation.surface: People taking part in boasting conversation who stare intently.
explanation.definitionFit: Gapers are people who stare openly with mouths agape, gazing intently at something.

clue.text: No jolly partner as a rule

parts.note: taken as written
a jolly is slang for a Royal Marine, abbreviated RM
an ally is a partner or associate

explanation.surface: A rule-book insistence that one's partner must not be cheerful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jolly' reads as cheerful, but in crosswords it is old naval slang for a Royal Marine.
explanation.definitionFit: Normally means usually or in ordinary circumstances, which is the sense of the phrase as a rule.

clue.text: The slowest often hold onto the port

parts.note: the run of letters starting after the first s and ending before the en

explanation.surface: Stragglers often clinging to a port rail.
explanation.walkthrough: Lowestoft is a fishing port on the Suffolk coast in eastern England, the most easterly town in the UK.
explanation.definitionFit: This Suffolk town is a harbour on the North Sea coast, long known for its fishing fleet.

clue.text: Many stay in, making ends meet when getting on

parts.note: eking out a living, scraping by

explanation.surface: Plenty of people stay at home to save money once they reach old age.

explanation.definitionFit: Embarking is boarding a ship, plane or vehicle, the action of climbing aboard for a journey.

clue.text: Love the German for "river"!

der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: An exclamation of fondness for the German word meaning river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oder runs along the border between Germany and Poland.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oder is a major Central European waterway flowing from the Czech Republic to the Baltic Sea.

clue.text: Smart retreat in a Mediterranean island

parts.note: smart means clever or capable

explanation.surface: A chic holiday hideaway on a southern European island.

explanation.definitionFit: Elba is the island off the Tuscan coast of Italy where Napoleon was first exiled.

clue.text: Quarter people in rented section

men are people

clue.text: Prepared for quiet drive, not breakdown

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A motorist ready for a calm journey with no car trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A provident person is careful to make provision for the future, so is ready and forearmed.

clue.text: He gets wine in France with very little money

parts.note: vin is French for wine
a cent is a coin of tiny value

explanation.surface: A man scraping by on cheap French wine.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'He': the answer is a man's first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Vincent is a male forename, so a man who can be referred to by the masculine pronoun.

clue.text: Weighty communication cut by a lawyer

taken as written
BL, Bachelor of Law, a law graduate

explanation.definitionFit: Notable means important or significant, deserving notice, just as a weighty matter carries importance.

clue.text: Parasites tail a well-qualified person for spite

clue.text: Blame fish salesman getting the order wrong

clue.text: A pound's enough for ecclesiastical attire
